scope.core: ALLOW execution/pagination exception receipt, non-string result references, follow-up test runners
scope.tts: Existing safe logging, typed encoding errors, retry/recovery health changes
scope.test_environment: Temporary SQLite stores and synthetic providers/tools; TTS fixture uses a temporary spool and an ephemeral local HTTP server

findings.title: Hiding a local tool schema did not prevent execution
findings.original_evidence: With only an MCP schema advertised, a synthetic provider returned clipboard_read. A harmless replacement callback was invoked and its synthetic marker reached the next provider request. No real clipboard was read.
findings.fix: followup_models.py now clears tool_registry and wraps execution with selected_synthetic_execute restricted to the selected synthetic MCP names.
findings.verification: The same unexpected clipboard_read request through the actual Core now produces a failed receipt, invokes the callback zero times, sends no private marker to the next provider request, and cannot be overridden by synthetic success prose.

findings.title: Raw tool-turn messages could expose reasoning in evidence
findings.original_evidence: A synthetic assistant tool-call message containing reasoning_content is preserved in the next Core request; the original runner recorded these messages without projection.
findings.fix: followup_models.py applies public_messages to both request messages and response messages.
findings.verification: Executed the actual ObservedProvider class with an in-memory transport substitute. Reasoning fields and thinking content blocks were removed from both directions; visible text and tool arguments were preserved; original request bytes and returned response bytes were unchanged.

isolated_core_and_runner_tests.interpretation: The original counterexample test passes by confirming the former defect; the fixed-runner test separately confirms its closure.

verification.environment_note: An initial TTS test attempt used an interpreter missing pypinyin and failed at import. Re-running with the existing TTS virtual environment passed; no installation or environment mutation was performed.

limitations: Approval covers the reviewed source hashes and isolated Python behavior, not deployment or complete product acceptance.
A4 free-text false-pending behavior remains unresolved; no fix or acceptance is claimed.
No additional real-model run was performed, and the reported 18-case model transcript was not independently re-audited by this reviewer.
Public export of previously captured private records is the main agent's subsequent step; its output is not covered by this source-only review.

export_review.conclusion: PASS for this exported synthetic evidence snapshot
export_review.scope_note: This subsequent review adds privacy and publication checks of the exported evidence. It supplements the initial source-only limitations above; it does not independently validate model answer quality or real-world effects.
export_review.exception_trace_boundary: The exporter retains the last exception line while hashing the full trace. The current exported synthetic failure records passed the same credential/path scan; this approval does not treat the script as a universal redactor for arbitrary future exceptions.
